steps.text: scanner-glow-office (the director's follow-up of scanner-glow-bounds, Saleh's playtest of 2026-11-07, item 11): the sweep light stays inside the painted scanner's glass in the office view. Day 12 with every item (the scanner owned, the Auto-Feed installed, no tutorial). The passport goes from the counter onto the desk (the hand-over enters the reading view), DeskView.Return brings the office view. Part 1 (drop_office): the passport is dropped on the scanner in the office view; by Saleh's rule of 2026-10-28 (point 11, DeskController.DockAt) the machines take a paper in the reading view only, so the drop is expected to lie beside the scanner and bring the reading view. Part 2 (scan_office): back in the office view, DeskController.FeedStack (the Auto-Feed tray's click) feeds the passport, the scan (0.8 s) runs in the office view and is recorded as the frame sequence scan_office. Measure with PIL: the bar's and the cyan pixels against the glass rect, per frame.
